title: Just Performance!
description: This mod pack adds several other mods that optimize the game in different ways, without changing the gameplay or graphics.
body:
![Just Performance! Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6812eb81b8e695f5dfb39268be1a37ce5fe585f7.png)

Just Performance! is a modpack that focuses on optimizing Minecraft with some performance mods like Very Many Players and Entity Culling.

All mods are client-side.
